const input = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const promptLines = [
  '# Calendar Event Drafter',
  '',
  'Extract calendar event details from the content below.',
  '',
  '## Step 1: Detect Intent Level',
  '- explicit: Specific date + time stated (Tuesday May 7 at 2pm)',
  '- proposed: Multiple options offered (Tuesday or Wednesday)',
  '- soft: Vague scheduling intent, no time (sync soon, book some time)',
  '  Only draft if high-signal: external client, AJ, or deadline mentioned',
  '- null: Soft signal with no urgency -- return null, do not draft',
  '',
  '## Step 2: Extract Event Details',
  '- title: Short meeting title, infer from topic if not stated',
  '- start_datetime: ISO 8601, resolve relative dates using current_date',
  '- end_datetime: Calculate from duration. Default: +30min for calls, +1h for meetings',
  '- attendees: From participants + anyone mentioned',
  '- location: Google Meet/Zoom link, address, or null',
  '- description: One sentence on meeting purpose',
  '',
  '## Return JSON',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON:',
  '{"intent_level": "explicit|proposed|soft|null",',
  '"event": {"title": "str", "start_datetime": "ISO|null",',
  '"end_datetime": "ISO|null", "attendees": [], "location": "str|null",',
  '"description": "str"},',
  '"slack_confirmation_message": "str",',
  '"alternatives": ["str"]}',
  '',
  'If intent_level is null:',
  '{"intent_level": "null", "event": null, "slack_confirmation_message": null, "alternatives": []}'
];
const systemPrompt = promptLines.join('\n');
var content = input.content || input.body || input.email_body || '';
var participants = input.participants || input.attendees || [];
var sourceType = input.source_type || 'email';
var currentDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

return [{ json: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
  max_tokens: 1024,
  system: systemPrompt,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content:
    'Source Type: ' + sourceType + '\nCurrent Date: ' + currentDate +
    '\nParticipants: ' + JSON.stringify(participants) +
    '\n\nContent:\n' + content
  }]
}}];
